steps: Added the fixed safe-name allowlist constants and the private collectKernelEnv helper in src/runtime.ts and wired it into Kernel.spawn through the SpawnOptions env field so the Python child no longer inherits process.env; Windows names are matched case-insensitively and emitted in canonical casing, POSIX matches exact LC_* category names with no wildcard, values absent in the host are never synthesised, and no environment value is logged.

Ran strict TDD: appended the three M2 Issue#7 tests first (withHostEnvMap restores every mutated process.env key in finally and only booleans cross back from Python), observed 3/3 FAIL on base f4b7194 because the child inherited the host environment, then implemented the allowlist and observed 3/3 PASS within the focused 30s budget.

Ran the representative Issue#1 pattern (M2 Issue#1 successor: taskkill fallback, shared deadline, late abort) which drives the withPressedKernel PYTHONPATH/sitecustomize injection: 3/3 PASS, confirming PYTHONPATH remains available through the allowlist and the Windows taskkill host spawn is untouched.

Updated SECURITY.md, README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/architecture.md and docs/architecture.zh-CN.md to describe the implemented allowlist, the no-env-passthrough policy for custom python commands, the excluded proxy/venv/conda/PYTHONHOME/LD_LIBRARY_PATH/credential variables, and the credential-hygiene-not-sandbox trusted-execution boundary; Issue #7 is retained as historical tracking and V1 scope is not expanded.
